package.description: An agentic x86_64 ELF/PE binary decompiler to functional C99

en-US.description: An agentic x86_64 ELF/PE binary decompiler to functional C99
en-US.longDescription: dEXE accepts x86_64 ELF and PE binaries, disassembles them, lifts the assembly to an SSA-inspired intermediate representation, reconstructs control flow basic blocks, and outputs valid, compilable C99 source code.
en-US.name: dEXE
